currentIndex.tierDeclaration: No top-level tier declaration; these selector counts establish neither 8x nor Q92/material acceptance.

auditFindings.finding: Current auditor reads only pak0 of each official game plus bundled shareware pak0 for base; it misses other installed archives and loose assets and covers BSP textures only. Historical 967/983/etc generate counts are not current 8x deficit.

Variant map uses name plus renderer 16hex dual32 FNV-style RGBA key. Strong SHA256 RGBA is present but omitted from grouping identity; raw indexed/palette/full four mips/material flag sets absent. Renderer key is compatibility selector, not collision-proof authoritative alias ID.
Current entries hold map/pack/slot/face usage, but not archive directory/member hash and complete native source tuple. Exact aliases need all source variants/flags, not base-RGBA equality.
Catalogued checks file presence only. It does not prove actual 4x/8x dimensions, lossyQ92method6 encoder provenance, matching maps/master lineage or photoreal acceptance.

main.js source/web mounts owned Quake pak0 then bundled shareware pak0 then official mission pak0. Generic addon FetchMission loops pak0..9 and stops at first gap. Desktop mounts selected game base first, applicable loose pack before archive packs, archives winning. Do not assume Hexen independent-gap probing or loose-over-pak order.

smallestSoundAuditExtension: Keep renderer legacy key for selection/backward compatibility; add collision-resistant sourceIdentity from native dimensions/palette/indexed/RGBA/all mip hashes and per-source texinfo/material semantic flags with provenance. Distinct authoritative source identities may map to same legacy selector; surface collision explicitly.

Extend existing bounded pakDirectory/readMember/memberSearch path with explicit profile/source mount descriptors and optional loose files. Separate inventory of all physical source archives from actual runtime-effective member precedence; identify gaps/unmounted physical assets rather than silently counting them as runtime-loaded. Preserve current known-official source/web pak0 behavior in evidence; desktop/addon profile differs.

Validate BSP all4 mip offsets/lengths and permap texinfo flag sets/face animation reachability. Record palette origin, map member content hash, native indexed/fullbright/alpha semantics and occurrence provenance. Keep special sky/liquid/utility/animation buckets visible.

Inspect selected runtime image dimensions and hash-bound encoder/master receipts; distinguish missing8x, adequate raw pending qualification, authored verified tiers, runtime installed and owner accepted. Do not turn old4x or name-only presence into High coverage.

Add meaningful bounded fixture tests for duplicate name / same base RGB with different mip/index/palette/flags; missing pak/gap/loose shadowing perprofile; malformed mip offsets; correct 4x mistaken asHigh negative. Source-specific selected batch can qualify before whole-inventory rewrite.
Maintain explicit non-WORLD family pending rows. Do not invent a total missing count before native scope audit.
